tasks.description: Distinguish required and generic impact when cached writes must become immediately visible.
tasks.prompt: Plan the impact of making writes immediately visible through a cached Config.Net configuration proxy without waiting for the CacheFor TTL. Trace property and configurable-method setters through interception, path construction, value conversion, store fan-out, and the keyed cache. Identify the source and test changes that are actually required, then distinguish generic paths that should already adapt without edits. Preserve store precedence and no-cache behavior. Cite implementation and test files with exact line ranges. Do not implement the change.
